integrity: All 362,880 vertex orders and 2,634 nonempty faces are enumerated by an embedded deterministic standalone verifier. The exact 1,314-pair acyclic matching has one critical zero-cell and five critical four-cells; the resulting CW type is a wedge of five four-spheres. Complete Hasse acyclicity and independent mod-two chain ranks were replayed successfully.
limitations: Proved for the full strong matching complex of the unfilled nine-cycle only. No general cyclic theorem, equivariant splitting, or independently audited theorem is asserted. Earlier literature provides the integral homology, but not the homotopy classification.
title: Integral homotopy type of the full strong Morse matching complex of the nine-cycle
